title: Resize off the engine: a 4K phone clip runs out of RAM, and Resize is locked during every generation
description: Resize (image and video) runs a ComfyUI graph for its preview and its save. resize_video.json loads the WHOLE clip as float32 frames before resizing: Fabio's 14 s 4K 60 fps phone clip (822 frames, 2160x3840) needs ~82 GB, MemoryError on a 64 GB box (2026-10-10). Being an engine job, Resize is also disabled while Cue has any job and with no engine (MPI-253, MPI-856), so the user is pushed to Crop. Resize, flip, rotate and pad are plain pixel ops: sharp for images, streaming ffmpeg for video, as Crop already is. Brief in brief.md.
